entries.name: Diamond and two beads on a fine rule

alignment.method: Robust fit to native grayscale centroids along both outer plain arms; terminals and central ornament excluded. One rigid rotation, no independent-axis scaling.

recipe.notes: Complete observed Document Room ornamental dash. Fourfold bilinear grayscale sampling adds no source detail. A 48-sample-pixel local paper correction supports the fine ink. Uniform scaling and one measured rigid arm rotation preserve native proportions; native weak ink is retained. See document-dash-review.json.

entries.identity_reason: A and H share the central diamond and two side beads; arbitrary outer line length is not a new design. H has the more continuous plain arms. Native ink variation and the small left bead-to-diamond gap remain.
entries.quality_todo: Seek sharper complete matching impressions during remaining surveys. Retain native line variation and residual weak ink; no synthetic line, mirrored side, copied bead or filled gap is substituted.

classification: Eleven named specimens preserve ten ornamental constructions. A and H differ in outer line length and print quality and share one canonical design. Plain five-em and nine-em dashes remain with the separate plain-rule inventory.
identity_method: Full runs and central motifs were compared independently; 290 existing native dash, rule, lozenge and spindle candidates were visually reviewed. Exact central contour and component sequences determine the closest decisions recorded here.
sampling: Fourfold Pillow bilinear sampling of complete native crops, followed by local paper normalization at 48 sample pixels. This adds no image detail. Sampling is reproducible with prepare_document_dash_sampling.py.
